definitions.short: to resprout , i.e. propagate by shoots ; figuratively, to be perpetual
definitions.full: H5125. nun [ נִין נוּן, ] verb propagate, increase (si vera lectio) ( > denominative from נין Hup-Now SS; — Late Hebrew נוּן = fish , so Aramaic נוּנָא , , Assyrian nunu ; — Qal or Hiph`il ?) Imperfect ינין Kt; > Niph`al ינּוֺן Qr Psa 72:17 let his name have increase (or, if Niph`al, be propagated, spread ); but dubious, Vrss perhaps יִכּוֺן be established, endure .
